What degraded

  • The panel shipped at the round 3 cap at 7.50, under the 8.0 top rung. The art median of 7.3 is under the 8.5 craft floor, which stands down at the cap.
  • Round 3's integrity and reader judges hard-failed a typed 0 painted into frame 5's art. It was repaired and both judges cleared it, but the craft card was not re-requested.
  • Cyan still marks frame 1's UpToDate, AI off pill and screen, against cyan meaning only the tool. Recolouring them would have re-opened an accepted audition frame at the cap.
  • The 116 deterministic movement lines reverify.py wrote were not reworded.
  • tx-2026-0062 (Fort Worth answered 403) and tx-2026-0077 (one Senate archive claim not found) were left unstamped.
  • The craft refresh (Phase 1) was not run.
  • After the PR opened, CI's shipped_check refused stale FIG lines, an accent present on only two frames, an undeclared value cut and slide 2's GRID declaration. All four were repaired. The accent fix changed frames 5 and 7's pixels after round 3, rendering the tool's glow as pure cyan, and the art director re-read frame 7.
  • tx-2026-0257's decider is now the project page's words, IC2 Institute and Dell Medical School, without the university suffix, because the human lane groups file was refused to this run.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Publication assets

These are the deck and copy retained for the automatic publishing workflow. Social delivery status comes from the destination receipts, not from the deck's merge or score. Do not manually repost a destination that already has a successful receipt.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Forty clinicians will get Claude. Forty will get UpToDate with its AI switched off.

The split belongs to the AI Learning Lab, announced October 20th by the IC² Institute and Dell Medical School. Its 80 clinicians are faculty, residents and students. Each will meet a paid actor playing a patient.

Researcher Sookja Kang asks how fast clinicians click on their AI tool, whether they accept its output or interrogate it, and how much reasoning gets handed off. The release reports no findings.

What the release does cite is a 2026 American Medical Association survey, with 81% of doctors using AI against 38% in 2023. Vice Dean of Education James Korndorffer says AI is going to be used and should be.

Which of Kang's questions should a Texas medical school see answered before AI enters its curriculum?

#DellMed #ClinicalReasoning #MedicalEducation

Notes

The record. 151 items were due. 116 were stamped checked and unchanged. Seven claims of tx-2026-0024, the PUCT calendar feed, moved to the December and January listings. Six more items were checked against their own pages with written notes. Two were left unstamped at three days. Twenty six wait behind crawl boundaries still inside their seven day window. Admitted. tx-2026-0256 is TACC opening Horizon to early users. It carries Williamson County on Round Rock, though UT's page names no county, and a maintainer may reverse that call. tx-2026-0257 is the Dell Med and IC2 Institute AI Learning Lab, which is today's deck. The deck. Carousel no. 85, the fair test. 80 clinicians, half with Claude and half with UpToDate with its AI switched off, and Kang's three questions drawn as instruments at rest. No study results exist and no frame implies one. Panel. Round 1 scored 7.39 and round 2 scored 7.49. Round 3, the cap, scored 7.50 after a frame 5 hard fail was repaired and cleared. Social delivery runs after the merge through Upload-Post REST, and its receipts are added to this draft. Prompt audit and the no-stall hook. The final reading is taken in Phase 19 and replaces this line.

This email is a draft. Nothing was sent by email. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Social publishing is handled by the automation; destination receipts report what actually published.
